name: Sxbot
install: set -e; if ! python3 -c 'import ensurepip' >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq python3-venv; fi; python3 -m venv .venv; .venv/bin/python -m pip install -q --upgrade pip setuptools wheel; if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then .venv/bin/pip install -e ".[dev,trade]"; else echo 'no pyproject.toml on this branch; created .venv only'; fi
